about: A failed DIA-NN search (engine: diann): the tools read that engine's own console log.
question: Why did my search fail?

model.content:
DIA-NN stopped with an error; this is the line of its log that says so [log:1#4] [job:1].

Fix what the log shows and press Retry, or use Report a problem to send the log [help:attention.search_failed].
